groups.activity: run Tier 2 Arcana vaults; turn every matrix in to Loid
groups.mode: squad if it holds, else solo

rows.label: Necraloid Rank 1
rows.note: 5,000 standing, 10 Orientation Matrix, 150 Void Traces, 20 Father Tokens, Zymos Barrel Blueprint

rows.label: Necraloid Rank 2, Modus
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 15 Ballistics Matrix, 250 Void Traces, 20 Father Tokens, Sepulcrum Barrel Blueprint

conditions: Only Tier 2 (Lvl 40-50) vaults drop Arum Spinosa; Tier 1 and Tier 3 don't.
Clearing the normal Tier 2 vault unlocks its Arcana bounty, started from Mother in the Drift between Albrecht's Prospect and Catabolic Gutter, never from the Necralisk.
Matrix turn-ins count toward the daily standing cap (16,000 + 500 per MR), so expect several days of cap.
A broken vault exit can void the run's rewards.
bonuses: Tier 2 Necramechs drop Ballistics Matrices (2,500 standing each); Orientation is 1,000 and Animus 5,000.
A Resource Booster doubles matrices; Nekros Desecrate and Resourceful Retriever help on the Necramech kills.
Most runs end with spare Guards and no Rivet: bank the drops and spend 6,000 standing on the Rivet.

disclosures.title: Orientation Matrices for Rank 1
disclosures.body: Tier 3 bounties list Orientation Matrices but in practice hand out Animus. If you're short on the 10 Orientation, run Tier 1, where every Necramech kill drops one. Higher tiers spawn more Necramechs, so move up once Rank 1 is done.

disclosures.title: normal vault odds
disclosures.body: A plain Tier 2 Isolation Vault rolls the Blueprint at 6.25%, Guard at 3.75% and Rivet at 2%. The Arcana version roughly doubles that, and its final stage is the only decent Rivet source. Old advice about watching rotations for the Rivet no longer applies.

disclosures.title: pubs and squads
disclosures.body: Sporothrix and Arum farm squads run Arcana vaults regularly. Pubs tend to extract after the vault stage, which sends you back to the Necralisk; if they keep bailing, run it solo.

disclosures.title: buying from players
disclosures.body: Parts are tradeable; before the Loid listing a Rivet went for roughly 40-55 platinum.
